The '''N-4 noise grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] produced by Merr-Sonn during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It offered a nonlethal solution in situations where killing could lead to diplomatic or tactical complications. When deployed, it released a powerful burst of sound across the spectrum, causing intense but temporary pain in most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although the noise lasted only a few [[Standard second|seconds]], its lingering effects gave the user a crucial moment to escape or take control of the situation.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The N-4 noise grenade was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
